title: Kimi-maker Moonshot AI targets $2B in annual revenue | TechCrunch
summary: Earlier this week, Anthropic accused the company of a long-running model distillation campaign that routed nearly 300,000 requests from Kimi directly to Claude Opus, effectively serving Opus in place of Kimi’s own models.
